anchor_value: Short-Term Investments / money market fund excluded from cash equivalents

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Dreyfus Treasury Obligations Cash Management Money Market Fund | 3.65 % | 65,057 | 65,057 | 10.70%

The Company has made a prospective presentation change to reclassify money market fund investments as short-term investments, resulting in their exclusion from cash and cash equivalents as of December 31, 2025.

findings.detail: The current-period SOI row is a short-term money-market investment excluded from cash equivalents, but the extracted asset_class is CASH_EQUIVALENTS, outside the controlled classification axis.

rationale: C304 is a Class 1 row-level controlled-axis check on asset_class. The source schedule presents the row under Short-Term Investments and identifies the instrument as Dreyfus Treasury Obligations Cash Management Money Market Fund with fair value 65,057. The filing footnote states money market fund investments were reclassified as short-term investments and excluded from cash and cash equivalents as of December 31, 2025. Therefore the extracted asset_class value CASH_EQUIVALENTS is not source-supported and is a real controlled-classification error.
